_meta.indication: Treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in patients age 12 years and older who are homozygous for the F508del mutation in the CFTR gene

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel group study; patients randomized 1:1:1 to LUM 400 mg q12h/IVA 250 mg q12h, LUM 600 mg qd/IVA 250 mg q12h, or placebo for 24 weeks
pivotal_trials.population: Trial 1 evaluated 549 patients aged 12 years and older (mean age 25.1) with CF homozygous for the F508del mutation and ppFEV1 at screening between 40-90
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Absolute change from baseline in percent predicted FEV1 (ppFEV1) at Week 24, assessed as the average of treatment effects at Week 16 and Week 24
pivotal_trials.result: Treatment difference in absolute change in ppFEV1 vs placebo: 2.6 percentage points (95% CI 1.2, 4.4), P=0.0003

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel group study; patients randomized 1:1:1 to LUM 400 mg q12h/IVA 250 mg q12h, LUM 600 mg qd/IVA 250 mg q12h, or placebo for 24 weeks
pivotal_trials.population: Trial 2 evaluated 559 patients aged 12 years and older (mean age 25.0) with CF homozygous for the F508del mutation and ppFEV1 at screening between 40-90
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Absolute change from baseline in percent predicted FEV1 (ppFEV1) at Week 24, assessed as the average of treatment effects at Week 16 and Week 24
pivotal_trials.result: Treatment difference in absolute change in ppFEV1 vs placebo: 3.0 percentage points (95% CI 1.6, 4.4), P=0.0001

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥5%) were dyspnea, nasopharyngitis, nausea, diarrhea, upper respiratory tract infection, fatigue; e.g., dyspnea 13% vs 8% placebo, nausea 13% vs 8% placebo. Safety concerns of note were liver-related adverse reactions and respiratory symptom-related adverse reactions (22% ORKAMBI vs 14% placebo). Serious adverse reactions (pneumonia, hemoptysis, transaminase elevations) occurred in 1% or less of patients.
target_moa: Fixed-dose combination of two small molecules targeting defective F508del-CFTR protein: lumacaftor (a corrector) facilitates cellular processing and trafficking of defective CFTR to the cell surface, and ivacaftor (a CFTR potentiator) increases channel-open probability to enhance chloride transport
modality: Small molecule (fixed-dose combination of two orally bioavailable small molecules, lumacaftor and ivacaftor)
companion_dx_detail: If the patient's genotype is unknown, an FDA-cleared CF mutation test should be used to detect the presence of the F508del mutation on both alleles of the CFTR gene

advisory_committee.vote: Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) met May 12, 2015; in general the committee members were of the opinion that the submitted data are adequate to support approval of the lumacaftor plus ivacaftor combination product

summary.text: Orkambi was submitted as a 505(b)(1) NDA, received November 5, 2014, granted Priority Review (goal date July 5, 2015) and reviewed with orphan drug designation for cystic fibrosis; it was approved July 2, 2015 following a PADAC advisory committee meeting, with a single post-marketing requirement for a 24-month lumacaftor rat carcinogenicity study.
